verification.scope: All proposed Linux Git/lease scenarios independently rerun.
Four relative path keys; relative common/index directory with actual Git top-level oracle; retained Git URL rewriting configuration; symlink spelling for an environment-only worktree.

reasoning: The same copied environment snapshot is used for root discovery, remote lookup, worktree fallback and registry identity selection; caller process.env is preserved.
Relative path variables are resolved once against the original process cwd. Windows name matching uses uppercase for selection/removal while preserving unrelated variables.
Walking canonical roots stops at an independent .git boundary. Explicit GIT_WORK_TREE and configured core.worktree environments retain ownership without requiring a .git marker.
Using git config --name-only --get-regexp checks key presence, so an explicitly empty value is distinct from a missing key.

The implicit GIT_DIR-only case with no physical checkout remains intentionally ambiguous and retains the prior environment; the patch should not claim to eliminate all conceivable inherited-environment attribution.
evidence_limits: Windows-only cases were inspected but not executed in this Linux review.

Initial extra probes had two incorrect test expectations: GIT_COMMON_DIR changes Git's treatment of core.worktree; remote.origin.url is multi-valued. Original failed probe evidence is retained in additional-boundaries.json. Corrected probes use direct Git oracles; product code was not changed.
This review covers the two-file candidate at the listed content hashes, not a future revision or whole-project CI.
